title: Apple (AAPL) Launches Ads On Maps While Pursuing Siri AI Content Deals
title_zh: 苹果 (AAPL) 在地图上推出广告，同时寻求 Siri AI 内容交易
summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) has formally launched its 'Ads on Maps' platform, entering the local digital advertising market alongside Google and Meta.
summary_zh: 苹果公司（NasdaqGS：AAPL）正式推出“地图上的广告”平台，与谷歌和Meta一起进入当地数字广告市场。

title: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition
title_zh: SpaceX 正式完成 Cursor 收购
summary: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially a part of SpaceX.
summary_zh: AI 编码初创公司 Cursor 现已正式成为 SpaceX 的一部分。

title: Nvidia’s Secret $21 Billion SpaceX Windfall — How One Chip Deal Turned Into a Rocket Fortune
title_zh: Nvidia 秘密为 SpaceX 带来 210 亿美元意外之财——一笔芯片交易如何变成巨额财富
summary: Nvidia cut a check for an AI startup and woke up owning a massive stake in Elon Musk's rocket empire.
summary_zh: 英伟达为一家人工智能初创公司开出了一张支票，并在埃隆·马斯克的火箭帝国中拥有大量股份。

title: What Does JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Olympic Deal And Banking Exit Mean Now?
title_zh: 摩根大通（JPM）奥运交易和银行业退出现在意味着什么？
summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) has been named the first global banking partner of the Olympic and Paralympic Games, marking a new worldwide sponsorship role for the bank.
summary_zh: 摩根大通（纽约证券交易所股票代码：JPM）被任命为奥运会和残奥会的首个全球银行合作伙伴，标志着该银行在全球范围内担任新的赞助商。

title: JPMorgan Resets Knicks Valuation After Lakers Deal
title_zh: 湖人交易后摩根大通重置尼克斯估值
summary: Private buyers may be exposing a major sports-stock discount
summary_zh: 私人买家可能会面临体育股票的重大折扣
